_endpoint: PATCH /open-apis/bitable/v1/apps/{a}/tables/{t}/views/{v} (property.filter_info) — with POST …/records/search as the other route
_method: 20 view-route value spellings on one Checkbox field, each a single-condition filter_info, bracketed by 2 TEXT controls on the same view and 4 search-route arms
_verdict: 4 of 20 probed view-route Checkbox forms were accepted by Lark; 2 of 2 TEXT controls on the same view in the same run were accepted.
_note: LD-403 AC1-AC3. The consumer's four shapes are the first four rows; everything after them is this probe's own reasoned extension. A form NOT in this list is UNMEASURED, not refused. The table has 3 rows, 2 of them ticked, so an accepted filter that matches nothing is still visible as `rows_visible_through_view`.
_transport: larkdocio.common.transport.CredentialedRawHttpClient (urllib), paced 1.3 s. Raw rather than the shipped serialiser because the serialiser can produce only one of the spellings under test.
